label: Google Antigravity Access
description: A Google Antigravity login, for the GoogleAntigravity nodes' `access`: a Gemini API key or a Vertex AI key. One access for however many GoogleAntigravity nodes. A Google account login is not offered: Antigravity's SDK reaches Gemini with a key, or on your own machine with Google Cloud's application default login for Vertex AI; on your machine, leaving `access` out uses what your environment already has.

steps: Open aistudio.google.com, Get API key, and create a key.
Paste it below and name the connection. Calls are billed to that account.
In the Google Cloud console, create an API key for Vertex AI (its express mode takes a key alone, no project or region).
Paste it below and name the connection. Calls are billed to that Google Cloud project.

outputs.name: access
outputs.description: Wire into the GoogleAntigravity nodes' `access` input.
